description: Straiker DefendAI guardrail. Calls /api/v1/detect (chatbot) or /api/v1/detect?agentic (agentic) and returns a verdict based on the threat score. Mirrors the Kong, Azure APIM, and LiteLLM integrations: same payload, same agent-loop dedup, same blocking semantics.

apiKey.label: Straiker API key
apiKey.description: Bearer credential for the Straiker DefendAI app the verdicts should land in.

detectUrl.label: Detect endpoint URL
detectUrl.description: Base URL of the Straiker detect endpoint. Default: https://api.prod.straiker.ai/api/v1/detect

functions.name: Detect
functions.description: Score the request (beforeRequestHook) or response (afterRequestHook) with Straiker DefendAI. Set agentic=true for multi-turn / tool-calling agents (calls /detect?agentic and forwards the full conversation including tool_calls).

agentic.label: Agentic mode
agentic.description: When true, calls /detect?agentic and forwards the full messages[] including tool_calls and tool results. When false, single-turn /detect.

threshold.label: Block threshold
threshold.description: Score above this returns verdict=false. Range 0-1.

source.label: Source app name
source.description: Straiker Console app name. Should match an existing application; in agentic mode this distinguishes agentic apps from chatbot apps.

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: Upstream model host the request is being forwarded to (used in Console attribution, not for routing).

timeoutMs.label: Detect timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Per-call HTTP timeout for the Straiker detect API.

failOpen.label: Fail open
failOpen.description: When true, return verdict=true when Straiker is unreachable. When false, return an error and let Portkey decide.
